source.symbol: Custom Headers input label and dialog buttons
source.validation: Exact public Git source at the fixed comparison revision. Claims are static observations. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility validation ran.

text:
<dialog buttons="accept,cancel,extra1,extra2">
      <hbox flex="1">
        <vbox flex="1">
          <label
            id="headerInputLabel"
            data-l10n-id="custom-headers-new-msg-header"
            control="headerInput"
          />
          <html:input
            id="headerInput"
            type="text"
            aria-labelledby="headerInputLabel"
            class="input-inline"
            oninput="onTextInput()"
          />
          <richlistbox
            id="headerList"
            class="theme-listbox"
            flex="1"
            onselect="updateRemoveButton()"
          />
        </vbox>
        <vbox>
          <label value="" />
          <button
            id="addButton"
            data-l10n-id="custom-headers-add-button"
            dlgtype="extra1"
          />
          <button
            id="removeButton"
            data-l10n-id="custom-headers-remove-button"
            dlgtype="extra2"
          />
